Hi Chris, thanks for your patience, and here is where both stand.

Order Shop····, the Magic Miner 40T, ships October 31. The Miner Duster and the Power Kit on that order ship in the same box with it. You can follow that shipment on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Order Shop····, the BSB NerdQaxe++, is waiting on the next restock and I do not have a firm date for it yet, so I am not going to guess one. I have put that with the team to get the current date, and they pick it up tomorrow at 10am ET and will reply to you by email.

One small thing worth doing: our updates go to (email hidden), the address on both orders, and a few have been landing in junk lately. Adding (email hidden) and (email hidden) to your contacts will keep the tracking mail out of spam.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy support
